summary: The twenty REPD technology types the spine does not carry, added as tabs in the product's own technology row beside SOLAR, BATTERY, ONSHORE and OFFSHORE.
modification_note: Appends twenty tabs to the #tech row after the spine has bound its own handlers, so the spine's four tabs keep their listener, their payload and their render path unchanged. A wider tab paints the product's table from this cartridge's own payload; a spine tab runs the spine's own apply() and repaints from the spine's data. No spine payload, count, filter or ranking is read or rewritten.
section:
WIDER FLEET — TWENTY MORE REPD TECHNOLOGY TABS BELOW The DESNZ REPD carries 24 technology types. This product's four tabs carry four of them. The other twenty — landfill gas, anaerobic digestion, biomass, EfW incineration, hydro, hydrogen, advanced conversion, tidal, geothermal, compressed and liquid air, flywheels — are the additional tabs in the technology row, under the REPD's own names. Cut from the same REPD extract as the spine.
WAIT · register cut not yet read

registry_entry.mutation_scope: appends twenty buttons to #tech, and paints .tablewrap tbody only while one of those tabs is the active one
registry_entry.tabs_derived_from: the payload at mount time, never listed in source

source.upstream: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database, quarterly extract
source.role: the same REPD extract and the same classification the spine is cut from; no second fetcher and no second classification

registry_entry.scope: REPD technology types outside the spine's four. Capacity and status are the register's own fields. County, town, postcode, REPD ref and the GlobalGrid reference are spine joins and are withheld rather than guessed.
